errors: Auto-mode safety classifier returned no verdict on ~10 Bash calls (7 in a row at one point); waited by reading code, then retried.
A 'bash -c' A/B timing command with rm of a variable path was blocked by the safety check; rewritten as a script using find -delete on a literal directory.

doc_friction.issue: 'Where to look' item 3 names the venture test suite, but the useful pointer was the previous perf note's ranked 'Not changed' list; finding the newest note means listing ~150 docs/history/*perf* files by date. An index or a 'latest not-changed' helper would save a few calls.

rendererSource() hashes render3d.mjs from 'function draw()' to the first 'requestDraw', so editing draw() silently marks every stored render stale; nothing in render3d.mjs says so near draw(). Found by reading, not by docs.

notes: Metric: shed-designer browser.test.mjs wall time and Chromium GPU-process CPU seconds (4-core cloud container, Node 22.23.4, Playwright /opt/node-tools, no AXE). Before: wall 69.5, 72.0, 73.6, 76.1 s (mean 72.8); GPU-process CPU 92, 95, 100 s (ps sampled every 0.5-1 s, last cumulative time per pid). After: wall 64.5, 66.7, 72.1 s (mean 67.8); GPU 69, 77 s. Before/after runs alternated by copying each render3d.mjs version in. WebGL frames on page load (counted by wrapping clear(COLOR)): 11 -> 5; after one edit 5 -> 4. Equality: 14 toDataURL/canvas hashes (load, edit, make-options 8 cards) identical HEAD vs new. Tests: browser.test.mjs 43/43 every run; picker/gambrel/hoa/utilisation browser + renders.test 25 pass 1 skip; python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py shed-designer: ok, 537 tests, 185.9 s, 0 failed.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: profiling a Playwright suite, counting WebGL frames, a pixel-equality harness and A/B timing: about a senior engineer's half day

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
